# Premium UI Skill

## Purpose
Provide premium enterprise-grade UI guidance for modern SaaS applications built in this repository.

## Responsibilities
- Define responsive layout systems and spacing standards
- Enforce typography hierarchy and card design
- Standardize button and form patterns
- Maintain dark/light mode aesthetics and consistency
- Ensure component-level visual polish and minimalism

## Best Practices
- Use Tailwind utility classes consistently
- Keep spacing predictable with modular scales
- Use semantic HTML for layout and content
- Prefer reusable atoms, molecules, and layout containers
- Maintain consistent radius, shadows, and elevated surfaces

## Mandatory Standards
- Only use the approved color palette: #121212, #FFFFFF, #064E3B
- Use IBM Plex Sans typography only
- Keep UI premium, modern, minimal, and enterprise-grade
- Support dark mode and light mode in every UI component
- Keep animations subtle and accessibility-friendly

## Preferred Patterns
- Card-based layout for content grouping
- Fluid responsive containers with max-width constraints
- Consistent button and link styling with clear states
- Clear content hierarchy using headings, labels, and spacing
- Theme-aware utility classes and design tokens

## Avoid Patterns
- Colorful gradients or rainbow palettes
- Excessive shadows or glassmorphism
- Inconsistent spacing and typography scales
- Cluttered interfaces or too many visual chrome elements
- Misaligned layouts or non-responsive breakpoints

## Example Implementations
- Responsive feature card grid with hover state and dark mode style
- Minimal top navigation with accessible menu controls
- Premium hero section with clear title hierarchy and CTA button
- Form section with labeled fields, subtle borders, and spacing

## Performance Considerations
- Keep component render trees shallow
- Use Tailwind utilities instead of inline styles
- Avoid heavy third-party UI libraries for simple layout
- Prefer CSS-based transitions over JavaScript animation when possible

## Accessibility Considerations
- Use semantic elements and proper landmarks
- Provide visible focus ring styles for interactive controls
- Ensure sufficient contrast in both themes
- Support keyboard navigation and screen readers

## Output Expectations
- Clean, reusable UI components
- Consistent spacing and visual rhythm
- Theme-aware styles with minimal and premium aesthetics
- Responsive layout that works across mobile, tablet, and desktop
